objectives.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the latent field state
objectives.description: Develop and calibrate a probabilistic diagnostic method that fuses multi-source Earth observation (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, secured PlanetScope), meteorological data (ERA5 reanalysis) and field observations into estimates of the latent field state (root-zone soil moisture and crop water status, RQ3), returning full posteriors rather than point estimates. The project adopts Route B, the homogeneous-patch proxy (RQ2), within a methodological architecture that also defines the rigorous one-step Route A (direct probabilistic fusion) as an alternative.
objectives.measurable_target: A calibrated diagnostic model that outputs the target field-state variables (root-zone soil moisture and crop water status) with explicit, honest uncertainty (posterior/prediction intervals). The verifiable target is uncertainty-calibrated field-state estimation, not a fabricated accuracy percentage.
objectives.evidence_strength: source_grounded (methodology) + operator_confirmed (RQ2 route, RQ3 target state, RQ8 PlanetScope)
resolved_decisions: RQ3 = root-zone soil moisture + crop water status

objectives.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine for water-use-efficient irrigation choice
objectives.description: Develop the prognostic decision engine that turns the diagnosed field state into an irrigation recommendation: calibrate the FAO AquaCrop model in an uncertainty-aware way that retains an honest parameter posterior, run counterfactual irrigation simulations over weather ensembles, and select the option that best improves water-use efficiency.
objectives.measurable_target: An integrated decision engine that scores candidate irrigation decisions by water-use efficiency (WUE) under weather and model uncertainty, propagating uncertainty from diagnosis into the recommendation. The decision objective is water-use efficiency (RQ6, operator-confirmed).
objectives.note: The vault's objective-function machinery (Profit Based Objective Function METH-DEC-005) is the mechanism for scoring irrigation decisions by an expected-value criterion; RQ6 instantiates that mechanism with water-use efficiency as the chosen criterion. The uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration is the project's (vault-grounded) methodology; it is not attributed to the fellow.

objectives.title: Field validation and honest uncertainty calibration
objectives.description: Design and execute a validation protocol on Hungarian tomato farms (accessed via AgroVIR) establishing that the diagnosis and the decision recommendations are credible: collect non-destructive physiological ground truth, assess whether the reported uncertainty is well calibrated, and test that Route B's chosen homogeneous patch genuinely covaries with the target crop.
objectives.measurable_target: A validation protocol with defined ground-truth measurements (RQ4: chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy/leaf temperature, spectral reflectance), an uncertainty-calibration criterion (RQ5: 90% prediction intervals contain the truth about 90% of the time), a pilot-success criterion (RQ7: the RQ5 calibration target is met on the validation set), and a patch-covariation test (RQ9: a co-located seasonal campaign measuring the target crop and the proxy patch simultaneously, demonstrating statistical covariation). No validation numbers are asserted beyond these operator-confirmed criteria.
resolved_decisions: RQ7 = pilot success = RQ5 target met on the validation set

coherence_note.reasoning: RQ3 keeps root-zone soil moisture within the target field state, but the RQ4 non-destructive physiological measures (chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy/leaf temperature, spectral reflectance) validate the crop-water-status component directly and the root-zone soil-moisture component only indirectly. This is recorded as a coherence caveat, not a gap; no soil-moisture sensor plan is fabricated here.

objectives.title: Standalone research demonstrator (web MVP)
objectives.description: Integrate the diagnosis and decision engine into a standalone research demonstrator (a web MVP / user interface) that presents recommendations with their uncertainty, as a research artefact rather than an operational product.
objectives.measurable_target: A working end-to-end demonstrator that exercises the full observation-to-decision pipeline. The TRL target is a research prototype, TRL 3-4 (RQ10, operator-confirmed).
source_vault_nodes: Web MVP and User Interface Layer (METH-INFRA-010)
objectives.note: The demonstrator framing is vault synthesis (the Web MVP node is synthesis, confidence low), hence Inferred. The TRL target is now resolved: research prototype, TRL 3-4 (RQ10).

objectives.title: Advancement of the fellow's competences and career
objectives.description: Enhance the researcher's scientific, technical and transferable competences and career perspectives through the fellowship's training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge (MSCA-PF Impact criterion 2.1 / Excellence criterion 1.3). The two-way transfer is bidirectional: the fellow brings plant-physiology and non-destructive stress-phenotyping expertise (biological ground truth) to the host's geoinformatics and remote-sensing group; the host provides geoinformatics, remote sensing, and hyperspectral/multisensor-fusion methods and infrastructure to the fellow.
objectives.measurable_target: By month 24: a Career Development Plan prepared jointly by supervisor and fellow and submitted as a project deliverable at the start of the action, then reviewed and updated during the fellowship; structured transferable-skills training covering the MSCA-PF mandatory dimensions (digital and AI skills, including responsible use of generative AI in remote-sensing and crop-water modelling and scientific coding; knowledge valorisation; innovation and entrepreneurship; research integrity; and open science / FAIR data stewardship); peer-reviewed publication and conference dissemination of the project's results; and two-way transfer of knowledge evidenced by methods exchange between the fellow and the host group. Specific quantitative targets (publication counts, training hours, thesis co-supervision, seminar counts) are deliberately NOT asserted - none were operator-provided - and are to be fixed in the Career Development Plan with the supervisor.
objectives.evidence_strength: operator_confirmed (two-way transfer content; real fellow/supervisor/host) + instrument_requirement (Career Development Plan as a start-of-action deliverable; training across the MSCA-PF mandatory transferable dimensions)
objectives.note: Grounded in the operator-confirmed identity spine and two-way transfer plus the MSCA-PF structural requirements (Excellence 1.3, SR-04/SR-05). No fellow-specific quantitative career figures are invented.
